subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which Feishu bind grammar should OpenClaw support before any candidate for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95734 is merged?
rationale: The central fix is real, but the PR changes a documented CLI grammar and persisted binding shape while multiple open candidate PRs propose different compatibility tradeoffs.

options.title: Preserve account semantics and add a safe peer path
options.body: Keep documented `channel:account` and channel-only behavior intact, then add either explicit peer syntax or plugin-owned Feishu conversation recognition with docs and upgrade proof.

options.title: Adopt another candidate PR
options.body: Pause this PR and use another open Feishu candidate if it better matches the desired grammar and proof requirements.

options.title: Accept this new grammar intentionally
options.body: Proceed with `feishu:account:<id>` only after documenting the breaking semantic change and proving existing account-scoped setups remain expressible.

recommendation.title: Preserve account semantics and add a safe peer path
recommendation.body: Keep documented `channel:account` and channel-only behavior intact, then add either explicit peer syntax or plugin-owned Feishu conversation recognition with docs and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans public CLI docs, route matching, and compatibility policy, and this person is a recent contributor across those surfaces.
